# PCSS II Robotics

> Student robotics projects, technical notes, simulations, and STEM outreach associated with Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II) in Saugus, Massachusetts.

Website: https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/
Site author: Aarti S Ravikumar — https://ai-aarti.com/
School: Pioneer Charter School of Science II (PCSS II) — https://saugus.pioneercss.org/

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/): Overview of the site and its sections.
- [Robotics learning lab](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/research/): Interactive mecanum drive model with educational wheel speed estimates.
- [Robot engineering and CAD](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/robots/): Designs, mechanisms, and robot histories.
- [Autonomous simulator](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/simulator/): Educational path planning and control interactions.
- [Jams and events](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/outreach/): Hack Club Haven details, a PAT game programming link, and Circuit 2026 history.
- [PAT game programming](https://pat.pcssiirobotics.org/): A learning resource linked from the homepage and footer beyond the jam.
- [Team and author](https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/team/): Ways to participate, school contact information, and the author's portfolio.

For a longer plain-text overview, see https://www.pcssiirobotics.org/llms-full.txt.

Technical reports, test results, sponsorship terms, and event dates should be checked against their linked primary sources before quotation. This site does not guarantee third-party citation or indexing.
